name: lazysql
description: Terminal-based SQL database browser with intuitive navigation and query execution

tools.description: Interactive terminal UI for browsing and querying SQL databases with vim-like navigation
tools.usage:
lazysql # Connect to database interactively
lazysql -host localhost -port 5432 -user postgres -dbname mydb # PostgreSQL connection
lazysql -config config.yml # Load connection from config file
lazysql mysql://user:pass@localhost/db # MySQL connection string
